principles: Stabilize safety and window of tolerance before insight, exposure, or exile/parts excavation.
Match plan to primary maintaining process (avoidance, emotion dysregulation, ambivalence, attachment cycle).
When switching: summarize what worked, name the new focus, keep one carry-forward skill, pause the old homework.
Never claim licensed diagnosis; invite coach/clinician for formal treatment planning.
Faith modalities only with explicit client request/permission.
protocol_steps: Name why the current plan is a poor fit (stuck ≥2 weeks, worsening, wrong target, client request).
Pick target plan_id from switch_to_plan_ids or search directory.
Mark old plan paused/abandoned with adaptation_log reason.
Activate new plan at step 1; keep one bridging technique.
Confirm with client in plain language; notify coach when therapeutic plans enabled.
